regions.merged_text: "Good News To-day !" Exclaimed Fr. Guard. This A.M. His niece and god-child L.F. 18 of Brooklyn had been giving family anxiety through, what was feared, blindly loving a non-catholic Sailor from St. Louis (W.M.) Like all good girls in such friendships she hoped to convert him - bringing him to the Monastery and enquiring about the S.M.A. May 4th she returned and enrolled him as perpetual member May 4th, sending him certificate etc. to St. L. Everything was returned this A.M. - Spell seems broken and danger feared by family and (real) friends averted. L.F. seems resigned.

regions.merged_text: Andrew J. Byrnes 52 139 Quincy St. N.Y. away from home 3 months, drinking ocassionally and negligent to-ward dependents was enrolled for one year in hopes of information, February 29th. To-day reported to have died May 8th in Kings Co. Hospital after receiving all Sacraments -- his friends with him. & served Mass faithfully as a boy for 7 yrs. -- Raves about loved pas- tor of boy-hood His family friends much appreciative and grateful to God for favorable death. Death Bed Brings Sacraments.
